freeze_basis: Predeclared Stage-9.5 protocol obligations plus Q1 adversarial register; no Stage-10 treatment outcomes accessed.

hard_gate.prerequisite: Resolve Stage 9.5-1/9.5-6 exact System-A checkpoint provenance blocker and complete Stage 9.5-9 with zero unresolved Class-A defects.

master_obligations.requirement: Direct attack-pattern / conditional-label-change scenario frozen before outcomes.
Gradual drift and unseen/evolving-attack designs frozen where scientifically defensible.
Second flow-oriented dataset inclusion/exclusion criteria frozen before outcomes.
Corrected-CICIDS/LYCOS or improved-reconstruction sensitivity frozen where scientifically useful; does not substitute for second dataset.
Candidate selection strengthened using independent confirmation or nested equivalent.
Prospectively test withdrawal/lifecycle authority semantics because accepted mechanism is withdrawal-dominant.
Test a defensible alternative symbolic evidence horizon.
Retain MCSC unchanged while triangulating coverage, class correctness, neural fidelity, conflict, stability, complexity, churn/version persistence, and temporal continuity.
Quantify 100-bootstrap gate granularity and include higher-replicate sensitivity where feasible.
Alternative periodic/random-clock schedules are required before any trigger-superiority claim.
Label-noise, missing-label, and replay-poisoning stress is required before operational robustness claims.
Second materially different neural backbone required before architecture-invariant claims.
Label-free monitor may be added as separately frozen diagnostic/replication; primary monitor is not retrospectively replaced.
Refresh literature adversarially before each major replication milestone and immediately before submission.
Preserve no-natural-drift-ground-truth, no real-time/deployment, no adversarial-robustness, no analyst-usefulness, and no first-ever claim boundaries unless separately evidenced.

inferential_rules: No robustness or replication result may replace an inconvenient accepted primary result.
No new test chosen after outcome access may be described as prospectively confirmatory.
Primary n=5 is not extended after outcome inspection to chase significance.
Trigger superiority requires separately frozen comparator-clock sensitivity.
Architecture-invariant or operational-security claims activate their conditional obligations before claim use.
